tiles.turns: Each tiles.*: a stat tile's label on the Overview page, over the chosen range. "Turns": answers from socios (AI agents), one per message they answer.
tiles.failed: Turns that ended in an error.
tiles.people: People who wrote to a socio in the range.
tiles.chats: Chats that had at least one turn in the range.
tiles.tokens: Units the AI model counts text in, summed over the turns.
metrics.turns: Each metrics.*: a choice in the chart's menu and the chart's heading. The same words as tiles.*.
axis.turns: Each axis.*: the chart's value in its accessible description ("Bar chart of turns by day…"); lowercase, as it sits inside a sentence. The same as metrics.*.
chart: Accessible name of the menu that picks what the chart shows.
no-chart: In place of the chart when the range has no data.
turns.title: Heading of the card listing turns (answers from socios), and the list's accessible name.
turns.description: Under the heading. "Socio" is a product noun (an AI agent). The access log records each time an admin opens a person's chat.
turns.empty: In place of the list when the range has no turns.
turns.tokens: In a turn's row: how many tokens (units the AI model counts text in) it used. Followed by its start time.
turns.open: Link in a turn's row that opens its chat's transcript.
turns.open-label: Accessible name of that link. {{socio}} is the socio's name (an AI agent); {{when}} the turn's start, a date and time.
status.running: Each status.*: a badge on a turn's row, how it stands or ended. Running: still working.
status.stopped: Someone stopped the turn before it finished.
status.interrupted: The turn was cut off (by a restart or a lost connection) and didn't finish.
